Machupicchu Ecolodge: Experience Machu Picchu from Your Room
Skip to content
Imagine waking up to panoramic views of Machu Picchu, lush valleys, and majestic peaks. Each room at Machupicchu ecolodge offers breathtaking vistas of these iconic landscapes, providing a sense of peace and connection with nature. Whether you re here to explore ancient Inca history, hike through stunning landscapes, or simply unwind, our prime location sets the stage for an unforgettable experience.
Step into the heart of the Andes and immerse yourself in authentic Peruvian culture. From savoring locally inspired cuisine to learning traditional crafts, every aspect of your stay is designed to connect you with the rich heritage of this extraordinary region. Our lodge is not just a gateway to adventure—it s a gateway to the soul of the Andes.
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, we believe in protecting the pristine environment that surrounds us. Our lodge is fully solar-powered, providing eco-conscious lighting while preserving the natural beauty of the area. Plus, our meals are crafted from ingredients grown right here in our own natural surroundings. Our philosophy ensures you enjoy fresh, organic, and flavorful dishes while supporting sustainable practices.
Every stay includes a delicious dinner and breakfast, hot showers to recover you after a day of exploration, and optional campfire experiences under the starry Andean skies—a perfect way to end your day.
Experiences
Nothing prepares you for the feeling of awe as you gaze upon the ruins of The Lost City of the Incas for the very first time.
Our family
Live with a local family during your overnight stay, make new friends and learn about their customs if you are looking for immerse yourself in a living culture.
Culture
The mystery: everywhere you go, there’s a sense that the Inca culture still permeates every hilltop, village and valley.
Machu picchu Ecolodge: Where the Salkantay trek meets relaxation
We are located in the rain forest. one of the most fantastic protected areas in South America is an unique place that is perfectly combine with your trekking to Machupichu by the Salcantay pass. It was created for travelers looking for unique experiences and beauty of nature, designed to relax with privileged to admire Machupicchu, Huaynapicchu, Machupicchu Mountain, Salcantay and many other big mountains and nature views. This stylish retreat lets you beat the citadel s crowds.
Surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of the Andes, our lodge offers comfortable rooms, delicious local cuisine, and a tranquil atmosphere. Whether you re exploring Machu Picchu or simply seeking a peaceful escape, this is the perfect place to relax and recharge. Located just a short distance from the iconic Machu Picchu, our ecolodge blends convenience with natural serenity. Wake up to stunning mountain views, enjoy personalized service, and experience the warm hospitality of the region. At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, every detail is designed to make your journey unforgettable.

Die Hütte war groß, hatte ein Doppelbett und ein Einzelbett sowie einen kleinen Schreibtisch. Das Doppelbett war bequem und es gab viele warme Decken. Als wir die Übernachtung gebucht hatten wurde uns vorab gesagt, dass es kein Strom zum aufladen von Handys und kein Internet gibt, was wir aber überhaupt nicht brauchten. Die EcoLodge ist ein ruhiges Örtchen, in der man sich gut vom Salkantay Trek ausruhen kann. Die Dusche und Toilette waren sauber und es gab sehr heißes Wasser. Die Hausherrin war super freundlich und hatte uns direkt nach unserer Ankunft ein Teleskop hingestellt, um sich Machu Picchu besser ansehen zu können. Das Essen war reichhaltig, sehr lecker und sie ist auf unsere Bitten bezüglich des Essens eingegangen. Außerdem durften jederzeit so viel Tee und Kaffee trinken, wie wir wollten. Es war mit Abstand die Beste Unterkunft auf dem Salkantay Trek! Wir würden jederzeit wieder hierher kommen.

Our Rooms - Machupicchu Ecolodge
Skip to content
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, we take pride in offering accommodations that blend comfort with the stunning natural beauty of the Andes. Whether you’re an intrepid solo traveler, a couple seeking a romantic getaway, or friends and family exploring together, our rooms are thoughtfully designed to provide you with a unique and restful experience. All of our rooms boast panoramic views of the majestic Machu Picchu, the lush valley, and the surrounding mountains, making your stay truly unforgettable.
As part of your experience, we provide a delicious dinner and breakfast, a hot shower to recover you after your adventures, and a serene environment to help you connect with nature. Our lodge operates off-grid using solar power for lighting, offering a sustainable stay while disconnecting from the modern world. While we don’t offer internet or electricity for charging devices, mobile network coverage is available. Additionally, guests can enjoy the magical experience of a campfire for an additional cost.
Single Rooms
Designed for solo travelers or those seeking their own tranquil retreat, our Single Rooms provide a cozy, private space with all the essentials for relaxation. Each room features a comfortable single bed with soft, quality linens and Andean-inspired decor. From your window, you’ll wake up to the breathtaking sights of the Andes and Machupicchu, setting the tone for a day of adventure.
Amenities:
Single bed with bedding
Panoramic views of Machu Picchu and the surrounding valley
Dinner and breakfast included
Solar-powered lighting

The warm, rustic design of the room incorporates natural elements, reflecting the beauty of the Andes. Relax in your room as you take in the sweeping mountain and valley views that surround our lodge.

Matrimonial Rooms
Our Matrimonial Rooms are perfect for couples seeking a romantic escape amidst the serene beauty of the Andes. Featuring a plush double bed and tasteful Andean decor, these rooms are designed to create an intimate and relaxing atmosphere. After an adventurous day, unwind together as you soak in the awe-inspiring views or enjoy a meal crafted from fresh, local ingredients.
Amenities:
Double bed with bedding
Panoramic views of Machu Picchu, the valley, and surrounding peaks
Dinner and breakfast included
Solar-powered lighting
Unique Features of Your Stay
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, we strive to offer more than just a place to sleep—we create an experience that blends adventure, relaxation, and a connection with nature. Here’s what sets our lodge apart:
Panoramic Views
Each room is designed to provide unobstructed views of Machu Picchu, the lush valley, and the rugged Andes. Wake up to sunrises over the peaks and end your day with sunsets that paint the sky in vivid colors.
Hot Showers
After a long day of trekking or exploring, enjoy the comfort of a hot shower, powered sustainably by our solar energy systems.
Delicious Meals
Your stay includes dinner and breakfast, featuring fresh, locally sourced ingredients and traditional Peruvian flavors to energize you for your adventures.
Sustainable Living
Our ecolodge operates off-grid using solar power for lighting. While we don’t offer electricity for charging devices, this approach ensures a low environmental impact.
Mobile Connectivity
While there’s no internet at the lodge, mobile network coverage allows you to stay connected if needed.
Optional Campfires
For an additional fee, enjoy an evening around a cozy campfire under the starry Andean skies, creating memories that will last a lifetime.
Embrace Tranquility and Adventure
Whether you’re here to explore Machu Picchu, trek the Salkantay Trail, or simply immerse yourself in the beauty of the Andes, our rooms provide the perfect sanctuary to unwind and recharge. Without the distractions of internet or modern devices, you’ll have the rare opportunity to reconnect with yourself, your travel companions, and the breathtaking natural surroundings.
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, every detail is designed to create a harmonious blend of comfort and sustainability. Let the serene beauty of the Andes and the warm hospitality of our lodge make your stay a truly unforgettable experience.
Book Your Stay
Ready to experience the magic of Machu Picchu Ecolodge? Whether you’re embarking on a solo adventure, planning a romantic retreat, or exploring with friends and family, our lodge offers the perfect base for your journey. Book your stay today and discover the perfect balance of adventure and relaxation in the heart of the Andes.

About us - Machupicchu Ecolodge
Skip to content
Welcome to Machu Picchu Ecolodge, a place where adventure and relaxation come together. Nestled in the heart of the Andes, we provide a serene escape for travelers completing the legendary Salkantay Trek or exploring the wonders of Machu Picchu.
Our Mission
Our mission is to offer a unique experience that combines comfort, local culture, and respect for the natural environment. From our cozy accommodations to our delicious regional cuisine, every detail is crafted to ensure your stay is unforgettable.
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, we believe in the perfect balance between adventure and tranquility. Whether you arrive after days of trekking through the majestic landscapes of the Salkantay Trail or as part of your journey to Machu Picchu, our lodge is designed to help you unwind, recharge, and connect with the surrounding nature.
Our Commitment to Sustainability
We take pride in being more than just a lodge. Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our ecolodge is built with eco-conscious practices that minimize our environmental footprint while preserving the beauty of this extraordinary destination. We prioritize renewable energy, water conservation, and waste reduction in our daily operations. Additionally, we actively collaborate with local communities to support their growth and preserve their traditions.
Supporting the Local Community
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, we are passionate about giving back to the community that makes this region so special. By partnering with local artisans, farmers, and guides, we ensure that your stay not only enriches your journey but also contributes to the livelihoods of the people who call this area home. Guests can enjoy locally sourced ingredients in every meal and have the opportunity to purchase handmade crafts that celebrate the rich heritage of the Andean culture.
Your Stay with Us
Our accommodations are designed with your comfort and the environment in mind. Each room offers breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and lush landscapes, creating the perfect space to relax after a day of exploration. The natural materials and thoughtful design of our lodge reflect the harmony between modern comforts and the timeless beauty of the Andes.
In addition to our rooms, guests can enjoy communal spaces that invite connection and relaxation. From our cozy lounge areas to our scenic outdoor spaces, every corner of our ecolodge is designed to make you feel at home while immersed in nature.
Culinary Experiences
A stay at Machu Picchu Ecolodge is not complete without indulging in our culinary offerings. Our kitchen celebrates the vibrant flavors of Peruvian cuisine, using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Each dish is prepared with care, blending traditional recipes with contemporary techniques to create a dining experience that delights the senses.
Whether you start your day with a hearty breakfast before heading out to explore, or end it with a warm, flavorful dinner under the stars, our meals are an integral part of your experience.
Exploring the Region
Machu Picchu Ecolodge is the perfect base for discovering the wonders of this region. Located near the iconic Machu Picchu, our lodge offers easy access to one of the world’s most celebrated archaeological sites. In addition, the surrounding area is filled with breathtaking trails, vibrant wildlife, and opportunities to connect with local traditions.
Our Philosophy
Our experienced staff is here to help you plan your adventures, whether it’s exploring nearby ruins, embarking on nature walks, or learning about the rich history and culture of the Andes. For those arriving after the Salkantay Trek, we provide the perfect environment to relax and reflect on the journey you’ve just completed.
At Machu Picchu Ecolodge, we believe that travel has the power to inspire, connect, and transform. By providing a space where guests can experience the magic of Machu Picchu and the surrounding Andes, we hope to create memories that last a lifetime. Our philosophy centers on creating harmony—between adventure and relaxation, people and nature, and culture and modernity.
Join Us
Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or a mix of both, Machu Picchu Ecolodge is here to welcome you. Let us be a part of your journey to discover the magic of Machu Picchu and the stunning beauty of the Andes. Together, we can create an experience that’s not only unforgettable but also meaningful.
